# FG-REPO-0029

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_untested_touched_requirement_is_a_neutral_trace_never_a_failure` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この MR が触れる要件か作業項目に、@req の付いたテストがありません。テストに @req <要件 ID> または @req PBI-<番号>/AC-<番号> を付けてください。
- en: A requirement or work item this merge request touches has no @req test. Tag a test with @req <requirement id> or @req PBI-<n>/AC-<m>.
- id: Persyaratan atau item kerja yang disentuh merge request ini tidak memiliki tes @req. Tandai tes dengan @req <id persyaratan> atau @req PBI-<n>/AC-<m>.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/spec-trace` (M3 X4, plan 03 §5.4, plan 06 D-7; advisory, plan 03 §9-4) found a touched subject with no `@req` tag naming it anywhere in the head's tree: a requirement added or changed in this repository's own specification since the merge base with the target branch (a deprecated one is not touched), or a kanflow work item the merge request is linked to (`PBI-<n>`) without any test of one of its acceptance criteria (`@req PBI-<n>/AC-<m>`). A notice, never an HTTP error: the run concludes `neutral` and never `failure` (it blocks a merge only when a protected branch requires forge/spec-trace, and `neutral` does not satisfy a required check). In M3 the check looks for a tagged test, not for its result in a pipeline (that comes with the CI of M4, ADR-0017 §4.1.1).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/spec-trace; the summary lists every touched subject with `tested` / `untested` / `unknown`, why it is touched — spec_changed, tag_added, work_item_linked — and where). The trace of the whole specification at a revision: gstn spec trace --project <id> --ref <rev>. The work item links: gstn mr work-items --project <id> --iid <iid>.

## 対処 (fix)

Add or tag a test for the requirement (a comment or a name with `@req <ID>`; any language), or for one of the work item's acceptance criteria (`@req PBI-<n>/AC-<m>`). A requirement that no longer applies is `status=deprecated`. Nothing to change on the server.
